definitions.full: H2193. zaak [ זָעַךְ ] verb extinguish , only Niph`al be extinguished נִזְעָ֑כוּ יָמַי Job 17:1 (|| חֻבָּ֑לָה רוּחִי ). Elsewhere always דעך (q. v.), and so in cognate languages. Probably error for נדעכו .
